name: Screw terminal, 2 way, 5.08 mm (Phoenix MKDS 1,5/2-5,08)
summary: Green 2-way screw terminal for a board. Wires go in from the front; it stands 13.8 mm tall.
source: Phoenix Contact catalogue extract for MKDS 1,5/ 2-5,08 (1715721): 10.16 mm wide for 2 positions at 5.08 mm pitch, 9.8 mm deep and 13.8 mm tall on the board with pins 3.5 mm below, M3 clamping screws, wires up to 2.5 mm2 solid or 1.5 mm2 stranded stripped 7 mm. The 11.2 x 6 mm slot in front is a suggestion for bringing wires through a wall, not a Phoenix figure. KF128 and DG128 lookalikes share the pitch but not always the height.

electrical.note: 17.5 A at 250 V to IEC; UL lists 10 A at 300 V.
